name: Delivery to the Gnomes
summary: Kravel Koalbeard sends Delicate Car Parts from the Mirage Raceway to Fizzle Brassbolts in the Shimmering Flats. Fizzle has waited a long time for them, and Kravel asks you to keep quiet about one small piece he removed.

sections.title: A Piece Left Out
sections.body: Kravel Koalbeard sends the parts to Fizzle Brassbolts, who has waited a long time for them. Kravel admits he removed one little piece from Fizzle's order. He says it is small and worthless, and that Fizzle will not miss it. Then he asks you to trust him and leave it unmentioned.

sections.title: Fizzle's Verdict
sections.body: Fizzle Brassbolts welcomes the parcel. His hydro ratchets and repeater bolts have arrived at last. They will do well enough.

faq.q: Who sends the parts to Fizzle Brassbolts?
aliases: who gives delivery to the gnomes
quest giver delivery to the gnomes
faq.answer: Kravel Koalbeard sends the parts from the Mirage Raceway and asks you to carry them to Fizzle Brassbolts.

faq.q: What did Kravel Koalbeard take from the package?
aliases: what is missing from the parts
faq.answer: Kravel says he removed one little piece from Fizzle's order. He calls it small and worthless, then asks you not to mention it to Fizzle.
The parts go to Fizzle Brassbolts in the Shimmering Flats. The Mirage Raceway is also on those flats, where Kravel Koalbeard is found.

aliases: previous quest delivery to the gnomes
what leads to delivery to the gnomes
faq.answer: Before this delivery, you brought Kravel's package back from Ratchet in Parts for Kravel.
